scripts.k8s:images: for app in auth chat-app-backend link-shortener-backend image-upload-backend ai-summary-backend chatbot-backend; do docker build -f docker/backend/Dockerfile --target prod --build-arg APP=@chat/$app -t local/$app:dev . || exit 1; done && for app in home chat-app-frontend link-shortener-frontend image-upload-frontend ai-summary-frontend chatbot-frontend; do docker build -f docker/frontend/Dockerfile --target prod --build-arg APP=@chat/$app -t local/$app:dev . || exit 1; done
scripts.k8s:addons: helm repo add ingress-nginx https://kubernetes.github.io/ingress-nginx --force-update && helm upgrade --kube-context docker-desktop --install ingress-nginx ingress-nginx/ingress-nginx --version 4.15.1 -n ingress-nginx --create-namespace --wait && helm repo add metrics-server https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/metrics-server/ --force-update && helm upgrade --kube-context docker-desktop --install metrics-server metrics-server/metrics-server --version 3.14.0 -n kube-system --set "args={--kubelet-insecure-tls}" --wait
scripts.k8s:deploy: helm upgrade --kube-context docker-desktop --install realtime-chat-app kubernetes/helm/realtime -n realtime-chat-app --create-namespace --set global.image.registry=local --set global.image.tag=dev --set global.image.pullPolicy=Never --set seed.enabled=true --wait --timeout 20m
scripts.k8s:up: pnpm k8s:images && pnpm k8s:addons && pnpm k8s:deploy
scripts.k8s:dev: pnpm k8s:images && pnpm k8s:deploy && kubectl --context docker-desktop -n realtime-chat-app rollout restart deployment
